comments.body_html:
I have them here—Lotus, Euphoria, Scorpion, and a few others. Since I’m translating everything into my native language (PT-BR), I also recreated the images for these traders. But if I want to share them, I need to talk to the creator first, which I think is the right approach.

All of them follow the same pattern, as if they were part of the base game, which makes it feel inconsistent for a modded game—one trader looks serious, another looks like anime, and another has a completely different art style. That inconsistency bothers me. This idea actually came from that frustration.
